description: Give the log option that carries a file's history past a rename. DISTILL-CANARY-4a7b2c91

files.history/route-cards.tsv:
carry-on-through-a-rename	git log --follow	--follow
stop-where-the-name-changed	git log --stat	change counts per file
files.README.md:
# Barrowmere Foundry - pattern shop drawings

A drawing is renamed whenever a pattern leaves the shop, and the shop keeps every version of it in one repository.
The commands the draughters reach for are carded in history/route-cards.tsv.

turns.prompt: Barrowmere Foundry renames a drawing file when a pattern is retired, and the log of that file stops at the commit where the rename happened, so the earlier work on the same drawing cannot be seen. Give the option that makes the log carry on past the rename and keep listing the earlier commits of that drawing. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
